status: DEVELOPMENT ARTIFACT — not normative evidence, not held-out evaluation
provenance: newly written synthetic criteria; none copied from the v1.3.1 prompt examples and none drawn from the historical 113-item adjudication set

boundary_axes: negative requirement that is NOT an exception (S12)

cases.root_criterion_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1 at screening.
cases.boundary: H0/H1 — surface 'or' names a value range, not two propositions

cases.root_criterion_text: Adequate cardiac reserve as judged by the treating investigator.
cases.boundary: X5 — broad adequacy statement with no concrete local subrequirements

cases.root_criterion_text: Cytologically confirmed pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with a documented germline BRCA2 pathogenic variant.
cases.boundary: H2-B — diagnosis + independently required biomarker; confirmation stays with diagnosis

cases.root_criterion_text: Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding at the time of screening.
cases.boundary: H1-B + H5 — separate states, explicit OR

cases.root_criterion_text: Grade 3 peripheral neuropathy or Grade 3 ototoxicity, each persisting for more than 6 weeks after the last dose.
cases.boundary: X2 — shared dependent qualifier copied into both children; multi-segment text_span expected

cases.root_criterion_text: Adequate bone marrow reserve, defined as absolute neutrophil count at least 1.0 x 10^9/L, hemoglobin at least 8.0 g/dL, and platelets at least 75 x 10^9/L.
cases.boundary: H3/H4 — true umbrella fully operationalized by children

cases.root_criterion_text: The participant must satisfy all of the following renal parameters: serum creatinine no greater than 1.5 mg/dL, and estimated creatinine clearance at least 50 mL/min.
cases.boundary: H3 — closed, operationally exhaustive list under an umbrella

cases.root_criterion_text: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy, such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, or Sjogren syndrome.
cases.boundary: H3 — open/non-exhaustive list; named examples must not be split out

cases.root_criterion_text: Participants with a second primary malignancy are excluded, other than adequately treated cervical carcinoma in situ.
cases.boundary: H4/X3 — single exception span with explicit trigger at the end

cases.root_criterion_text: Prior thoracic irradiation and prior systemic chemotherapy are exclusionary, unless completed more than 12 months before enrollment.
cases.boundary: H4 + H6 — exception waives a composite main rule; main should recurse

cases.root_criterion_text: Anticoagulant therapy is prohibited; low-dose prophylactic heparin is permitted if the participant remains within therapeutic monitoring range.
cases.boundary: H4 — conditional allowance ('permitted if') encodes a waiver

cases.root_criterion_text: Serum potassium within normal limits without the use of oral or intravenous supplementation at screening.
cases.boundary: H4 — negative requirement 'without X' is NOT an exception

cases.root_criterion_text: Confirmed diagnosis of relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma and at least two prior lines of therapy.
cases.boundary: H6 — composite whose diagnosis child may itself split (mixed logic)

cases.root_criterion_text: In Cohort B only, participants must have received at least one prior anti-angiogenic agent.
cases.boundary: X4 — criterion text itself restricts applicability; cohort label copied verbatim

note: expected_* are MECHANICAL properties for integration checking only. This is not a hand-written gold standard and must not be used as an accuracy benchmark.
